question: In which year were the two most common causes of traffic accidents different from those in other years?
sql:
-- Let's see all years and their top 2 categories
WITH cat_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    c.db_year,
    co.pcf_violation_category,
    COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM collisions co
  JOIN case_ids c ON co.case_id = c.case_id
  WHERE co.pcf_violation_category IS NOT NULL AND co.pcf_violation_category != ''
  GROUP BY c.db_year, co.pcf_violation_category
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    db_year,
    pcf_violation_category,
    cnt,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY db_year ORDER BY cnt DESC) as rn
  FROM cat_counts
)
SELECT db_year, pcf_violation_category, cnt
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 2
ORDER BY db_year, rn
